messages:
lucy: quick alert 1 zel os-int8 canary failing some locale checks. BLEU -1.4 overall; spikes in zh/ja and intermittent RTL bracket flips.
hiro: any tiny repro so we can isolate tokenizer vs model logits?
lucy: pasted two minimal repros: baseline=zelos-fp16, cand=zelos-int8-q5a:
```
ZH INPUT: \"请把最新的会议记录(第2页)发给我。\"
BASELINE: \"请把最新的会议记录(第2页)发给我。\"
CANDIDATE: \"请把最新的会议记录 \uff08第2页\uff09发给我。\"  # space before paren

JA INPUT: \"昨日の会議で説明したルビ(ふりがな)を送ってください。\"
BASELINE: \"昨日の会議で説明したルビ(ふりがな)を送ってください。\"
CANDIDATE: \"昨日の会議で説明したルビ \u2009(ふりがな)を送ってください。\"  # U+2009 narrow no-break space inserted

RTL INPUT: \"המכתב (הערה) נשלח למנהל.\"
BASELINE: \"המכתב (הערה) נשלח למנהל.\"
CANDIDATE: \"המכתב )הערה( נשלח למנהל.\"  # parentheses mirrored in detok
```
omar: token dumps show extra token id mapping to U+2009 and U+0020 in candidate for zh/ja. RTL flip looks like detok mirrored parentheses after bidi transform.
peggy: infra notes: this build used quant-config q5a + kernel-fusion-v2 + detok micro-opt enabled. all three landed together.
lucy: plan: 1) run candidate weights with legacy detok path, 2) bisect kernel fusion vs quant config, 3) add quick char-span->token-span diff in onboarding.
canary-bot: canary summary: 800 samples, 28 zh/ja whitespace insertions, 5 rtl bracket diffs, delta BLEU -1.42. artifacts: s3://canary/zelos/3172468013/report.json
hiro: short-term: opt-out detok micro-opt in canary package and re-run. also add unit tests for no space insertion around punctuation/ruby.
omar: I'll start bisect job and post results. tagging @platform-i18n for unicode normalization checks.
lucy: thanks 1 will open a reproducer issue with snippets and dumps. ping if you want to triage live.
